# sing-box JSON Schema

Upstream: https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box

License: GPL-3.0-or-later. The bundled license and complete core source archive are in `../SingBox`.

`sing-box-1.14.2.schema.json` was generated by the official Windows amd64 sing-box 1.14.2 binary with `sing-box schema -o`.

`sing-box-docs.schema.json` was downloaded from https://sing-box.sagernet.org/schema.json on 2026-10-04. It may contain development-version fields or features absent from a selected build. The application uses a schema generated by its selected executable, not this documentation snapshot.
